crossRefs.note: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
“Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

translations.web: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.
